name: Sarawak Iban Backstrap Loom Display
description: Original static display of a Sarawak Iban backstrap loom type, with individual warp and weft threads, a raised heddle, an open resting strap and a simple banded sample rather than a reproduction of ceremonial cloth.
summary: Static study of a documented Iban backstrap loom type with genuinely separate crossing yarns and open tied strap.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original high-readable scope: constructed independently editable beam pieces, physical yarns and closed heddle/strap cords, exhibition supports and native Cycles thumbnail.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Interpretive display only, not a named loom or maker replica. Unrelated plain colour bands do not reproduce heritage or ritual motifs. Its blue-grey rigid supports are display fixtures, not presented as the loom. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.

attribution.credit: All model geometry, material colours, cloth bands, signage and studio render are original.
